propositions: PASS-path reuse synthesizes empty advisory/coaching/indeterminate lists instead of replaying stored sidecar findings, losing prior review's actual results
BLOCK-path reuse already correctly replays blocking/advisory/coaching from stored sidecar with reused notation; PASS path must match

CLI notation must unmistakably state rendered findings are last review's result replayed due to unchanged plan, not a fresh LLM run, and include recency anchor (verified_at_sha/timestamp) when available

Stored sidecar must be replayed on PASS reuse when it matches material fingerprint; absent/unreadable/contradictory sidecar degrades to empty lists but does not block reuse (attestation remains validity authority)
Both reuse paths must emit coverage.replayed_review with recency metadata and maintain coverage.llm_ran=False plus existing reuse flags for structured validation parity
